title: New tab and assistant landing
description: Optional landing on the new tab page introduces the docked assistant (`browser.oasis.welcome.shownNtpAssistantLanding` and related prefs).
content:
New tab and assistant landing

Optional landing on the new tab page introduces the docked assistant (browser.oasis.welcome.shownNtpAssistantLanding and related prefs).

What this is

The new tab page can show a lightweight assistant landing once, so new users discover the docked assistant next to their start surface.

How to use it

  • Open a new tab during first week of use; dismiss or interact with any assistant tip shown.
  • After you engage, the page behaves like a normal new tab again.
  • You can still open the assistant from the toolbar pill anytime.

Notes and limits

The landing is controlled by Oasis welcome/onboarding prefs; resetting profile may show it again.
